title: A constructible subset of a constructible subset is constructible
statement: Let X be a topological space with a basis consisting of quasi-compact open subsets. Let E be constructible in X and let F be a subset of E that is constructible in the subspace E [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then F is constructible in X (Topology Tag `09YJ`).

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YJ (Lemma 5.15.12, constructible subsets local on a space with a quasi-compact-open basis)

proof.text: *Retrocompact subspaces inherit a basis of quasi-compact opens.* Let $T\subseteq X$ be retrocompact in $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Every open subset of the subspace $T$ is $T\cap O$ with $O\subseteq X$ open, and $O$ is a union of quasi-compact opens $B\subseteq X$ by hypothesis; each $T\cap B$ is open in $T$ and quasi-compact because $T$ is retrocompact. So the quasi-compact opens of $T$ form a basis of its topology. By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-is-retrocompact] (Stacks 09YH) every constructible subset of $X$ is retrocompact, so this applies to $E$ and to every constructible subset of $X$.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YJ (lemma-constructible-in-constructible, line 2763), proof, first paragraph

proof.text: *Reduction to $E=U\cap(X\setminus V)$.* By [def-weil-constructible-subset] write $E=E_1\cup\dots\cup E_n$ with $E_i=U_i\cap(X\setminus V_i)$, where $U_i,V_i\subseteq X$ are open and retrocompact; each $E_i$ is constructible in $X$. By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-intersection-in-constructible] (Stacks 09YI) applied in $X$ to $E$ and $E_i$, the set $E_i=E\cap E_i$ is constructible in the subspace $E$. The space $E$ has a basis of quasi-compact opens (step 1), and $F$, $E_i$ are constructible in $E$; so the same lemma applied in the space $E$ shows that $F\cap E_i$ is constructible in $E_i$ (the topology $E_i$ inherits from $E$ is the one it inherits from $X$). Since $F=\bigcup_i(F\cap E_i)$ and a finite union of constructible subsets of $X$ is constructible ([def-weil-constructible-subset], Stacks 005H), it suffices to prove that each $F\cap E_i\subseteq E_i$ is constructible in $X$, i.e. to prove the lemma when $E=U\cap(X\setminus V)$ with $U,V\subseteq X$ retrocompact open.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YJ (lemma-constructible-in-constructible, line 2763), proof, second paragraph (reduction)

proof.text: *The case $E=U\cap(X\setminus V)$.* Factor $E\subseteq U\subseteq X$. The set $E=U\setminus(U\cap V)$ is closed in the subspace $U$, and its complement $U\cap V$ in $U$ is retrocompact in $U$: a quasi-compact open $W$ of $U$ is a quasi-compact open of $X$ since $U$ is open, and $(U\cap V)\cap W=V\cap W$ is quasi-compact because $V$ is retrocompact in $X$. Hence by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-image-closed-retrocompact-complement] (Stacks 09YG, with $Y=U$, $Z=E$, $G=F$) the set $F$ is constructible in $U$. As $U$ is open and retrocompact in $X$, [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-image-retrocompact-open] (Stacks 09YD, with $G=F$) shows that $F$ is constructible in $X$.
